release_status: STABLE — canonical release, merged to main. Promoted from RC1 (2026-07-21, initial collection) through RC2 (2026-07-22, enrichment pass) to this final 1.0.0 stable release. See CHANGELOG.md and reports/rc1_vs_rc2_comparison.md for the full history.

datasets_blocked.name: Primary Health Centres (PHC)
datasets_blocked.reason: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh each run several hundred PHCs; per-facility verification exceeds what search-snippet research can do at any meaningful field depth
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Bulk structured data export (e.g. HMIS/NHM facility registry) rather than per-institution web research

datasets_blocked.name: Urban Health Centres
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: State urban health mission bulk facility list

environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy in both RC1 (2026-07-21) and RC2 (2026-07-22) -- re-confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial each time via a live test fetch. All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; confidence scores capped at 88. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography in this release -- state/district fields are free-text values, not district_id references. medical_colleges_telangana_andhra_pradesh.attached_teaching_hospital and government_hospitals_telangana_andhra_pradesh.medical_college_affiliation are free-text cross-references to each other within this package, not enforced FKs. No relationship to Package002_Education in this release.

source_tiers_used: Tier 4 (Trusted news, for time-sensitive scheme-rename and regulatory-transition verification)
source_tiers_not_used: Tier 2 (Official social media -- not needed this release)
Tier 5 (Community sources -- excluded per package policy for factual data)

confidence_statistics.note: Improved from RC1's 82.9 average via stronger multi-source corroboration, still capped at 88 due to this session's persistent WebFetch restriction -- see docs/METHODOLOGY.md confidence_calibration section

known_gaps: Field depth is still reduced from the ~30 fields per entity named in the package brief. RC2 added email/specialties_summary/available_services_summary/government_scheme_coverage_summary (hospitals) and email/departments_summary/government_scheme_coverage_summary (colleges), but Latitude/Longitude, Google Maps Link, ICU Availability, Dialysis, Ambulance Availability, and Working Hours remain entirely unpopulated. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
